description:
v0.1 passed 'providers.endpoint' from providers.yaml to the adapter as '--endpoint <url>'. ARCH §4.4 reserves endpoint interpretation to the adapter; §12 scopes this as a v0.1 simplification to retire.

=== What to build ===
Pick one of (a) or (b) and document the choice in ARCH §4.4:

(a) Env-var handoff. The harness forwards a well-known env var (LERNIE_PROVIDER_<NAME>_ENDPOINT or similar) to the adapter subprocess. The adapter reads it, falling back to its built-in default. providers.yaml's 'endpoint:' becomes adapter-readable but not harness-consumed — the harness just passes the value through without interpretation. This keeps the harness ignorant of adapter URL semantics.

(b) Describe-driven discovery. The adapter's 'describe' output grows an 'endpoint_env' field naming which env vars the harness should forward. The harness calls 'describe' once at load, caches auth_env + endpoint_env, forwards both on every 'complete' invocation.

Either way: the harness stops passing '--endpoint' on argv to the adapter. tests/prompt_end_to_end.rs is updated accordingly.

=== Out of scope ===
- Changes to providers.yaml schema semantics beyond the one field's interpretation.
- Streaming (bl-d15d, separate backlog).

=== Dependencies ===
- None. Independent of tasks A-C. Could land first or last.

=== Testing ===
- Unit tests for whichever mechanism is chosen.
- Integration test: mock endpoint is still redirectable for tests (via whichever mechanism), and the adapter still talks to it.
- tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green.
title: Retire --endpoint forwarding; restore strict §4.4
